record_scope_reconstruction: The H1N1 measure applied across South Ossetian-controlled ABL crossings to ordinary non-exempt passage. It was wider than Odzisi alone and is not the Georgia–Russia international boundary. The accessible evidence does not enumerate a complete geographically resolved set of gates or an approved ABL geometry.
